<a id="naicscode"></a>

## NaicsCode

A single NAICS industry classification: its numeric code and industry title.

### Remarks

Surfaced as the option-entry type on the industry selector's field props so
`getOptionLabel` can relabel options from the raw code and title.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `code` | `string` | The NAICS classification code. Codes in the bundled list are six digits; a code already saved for a company may be four or five. |
| `title` | `string` | The industry title for the code. |
